content.bridge_context: Learning how heat energy moves from one place to another.

units.title: Temperature
units.explanation: A measure of the degree of hotness or coldness of an object. Measured using a thermometer.
units.dual_language_instruction: What is the normal body temperature? / शरीर का सामान्य तापमान क्या है?

units.title: Modes of Transfer
units.dual_language_instruction: How does heat reach us from the Sun? / सूर्य से ऊष्मा हम तक कैसे पहुँचती है?
